summary: Host Hotels & Resorts filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market equity distribution program allowing sale of up to $600 million of common stock from time to time through J.P. Morgan, BofA, Wells Fargo and other sales agents, with forward-sale agreements possible via affiliated forward purchasers. Last reported Nasdaq price was $25.78 on November 11, 2026. No price per share, premium or closing date is stated. Proceeds fund general corporate purposes; forward-sale shares borrow from third parties. Charter imposes a 9.8% ownership limit for REIT compliance. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
